qe: If an employee's income is ₹60,000, the amount he spends is 50% higher than his savings. Therefore, his savings (in ₹) is:
qh: यदि एक कर्मचारी की आय ₹60,000 है, और उसके द्वारा खर्च की गई राशि उसकी बचत से 50% अधिक है। तो उसकी बचत (₹ में) क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Expenditure savings se $50\% = \frac{1}{2}$ adhik hai.
Savings : Expenditure $= 2 : (2 + 1) = 2 : 3$.
Total Income $=$ Savings $+$ Expenditure $= 2 + 3 = 5$ units.
Given: 5 units $= ₹60000 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = \frac{60000}{5} = ₹12000$.
Savings = 2 units $= 2 \times 12000 = ₹24000$.
Atah sahi vikalp  ₹24,000 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Savings ko $100$ maan lo.
Expenditure $= 100 + 50 = 150$.
Total Income $= 100 + 150 = 250$.
Savings fraction of income $= \frac{100}{250} = \frac{2}{5}$.
Savings $= \frac{2}{5} \times 60000 = 2 \times 12000 = ₹24000$.
Atah sahi uttar '₹24,000' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: Total savings of P and Q is 30% of their total income. Their average expenditure is ₹28,000. What is the total salary of P and Q?
qh: P और Q की कुल बचत उनकी कुल आय का 30% है। उनका औसत खर्च ₹28,000 है। P और Q का कुल वेतन क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Total Savings $= 30\% = \frac{3}{10}$ of Total Income.
Total Expenditure $= 1 - \frac{3}{10} = \frac{7}{10}$ of Total Income.
Average expenditure ₹28,000 hai, isliye total expenditure $= 28000 \times 2 = ₹56000$.
7 units $= ₹56000 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = \frac{56000}{7} = ₹8000$.
Total Income (10 units) $= 10 \times 8000 = ₹80000$.
Atah sahi vikalp  ₹80,000 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Total income $= 100\%$.
Total savings $= 30\% \implies$ Total expenditure $= 100\% - 30\% = 70\%$.
Total Expenditure $= 2 \times 28000 = ₹56000$.
$70\% = ₹56000$.
$1\% = \frac{56000}{70} = ₹800$.
Total Income ($100\%$) $= 800 \times 100 = ₹80000$.
Atah sahi uttar '₹80,000' hai.

Exam point: ausat ka sootra - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: Aman saves 25% of his monthly salary. When his expenses are increased by 20%, he is able to save ₹3,000 per month. His monthly salary is:
qh: अमन अपने मासिक वेतन का 25% बचाता है। जब उसके खर्चों में 20% की वृद्धि होती है, तो वह प्रति माह ₹3,000 बचाने में सक्षम होता है। उसका मासिक वेतन क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Let Salary $= 100$ units.
Initial Savings $= 25$ units, Expenses $= 75$ units.
Expenses increase by $20\% \implies 75 + (20\% \text{ of } 75) = 75 + 15 = 90$ units.
New Savings $= 100 - 90 = 10$ units.
Given: 10 units $= ₹3000 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = ₹300$.
Monthly Salary (100 units) $= 100 \times 300 = ₹30000$.
Atah sahi vikalp  ₹30,000 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Income $= 100\%$.
Initial Expenses $= 75\%$, Savings $= 25\%$.
New Expenses $= 75\% \times 1.20 = 90\%$.
New Savings $= 100\% - 90\% = 10\%$.
Given: $10\% = ₹3000 \implies 100\% = ₹30000$.
Atah sahi uttar '₹30,000' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: The income of A is 20% more than that of B. A got a 20% rise in his income, and B got a 30% rise in his income. The percentage increase in their combined income is:
qh: A की आय B की आय से 20% अधिक है। A की आय में 20% की वृद्धि हुई, और B की आय में 30% की वृद्धि हुई। उनकी संयुक्त आय में प्रतिशत वृद्धि क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio / Weighted Average Method):
$20\% = \frac{1}{5} \implies$ B ki income $= 5$ units, A ki income $= 6$ units.
Combined initial income $= 6 + 5 = 11$ units.
Rise in A's income $= 6 \times 20\% = 1.2$ units.
Rise in B's income $= 5 \times 30\% = 1.5$ units.
Total rise $= 1.2 + 1.5 = 2.7$ units.
Percentage increase in combined income:
$= \frac{2.7}{11} \times 100\% = \frac{270}{11}\% \approx 24.55\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  24.55% hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
B ki income $= 100$ maan lo, A ki income $= 120$.
Combined income initially $= 100 + 120 = 220$.
New income of A $= 120 + 24 = 144$.
New income of B $= 100 + 30 = 130$.
New combined income $= 144 + 130 = 274$.
Combined increase $= 274 - 220 = 54$.
Percentage increase $= \frac{54}{220} \times 100\% = \frac{270}{11}\% \approx 24.55\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '24.55%' hai.

Exam point: pratishat ka hisaab - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: Aman spends 80% of his income. If his income increases by 25% and his expenditure also increases by 15%, how much percent will Aman's savings increase?
qh: अमन अपनी आय का 80% खर्च करता है। यदि उसकी आय में 25% की वृद्धि होती है और उसके खर्च में भी 15% की वृद्धि होती है, तो अमन की बचत में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि होगी?
e:
Method 1 (100-Base Method):
Initial Income $= 100$ maan lete hain.
Expenditure $= 80$, Savings $= 100 - 80 = 20$.
Income me $25\%$ hike $\implies$ New Income $= 125$.
Expenditure me $15\%$ hike $\implies 80 + (15\% \text{ of } 80) = 80 + 12 = 92$.
New Savings $= 125 - 92 = 33$.
Savings me increase $= 33 - 20 = 13$ units (20 ke base par).
Percentage increase in savings $= \frac{13}{20} \times 100\% = 65\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  65% hai.

Method 2 (Ratio / Allegation Method):
Expenditure : Savings $= 80 : 20 = 4 : 1$.
Overall Income increase $= 25\%$, Expenditure increase $= 15\%$.
Savings increase ko $x\%$ maan lo:
$1 \times (x - 25) = 4 \times (25 - 15) \implies x - 25 = 40 \implies x = 65\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '65%' hai.

Exam point: pratishat ka hisaab - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: The ratio of Priya's expenditure and savings is 3:2. If her income and expenditure increase by 25% and 15% respectively, find the percentage increase in her savings.
qh: प्रिया के खर्च और बचत का अनुपात 3:2 है। यदि उसकी आय और खर्च में क्रमशः 25% और 15% की वृद्धि होती है, तो उसकी बचत में प्रतिशत वृद्धि ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Method 1 (100-Base Scaling Method):
Expenditure $= 300$, Savings $= 200 \implies$ Total Income $= 500$.
Income increase ($25\%$): $500 + 125 = 625$.
Expenditure increase ($15\%$): $300 + 45 = 345$.
New Savings $= 625 - 345 = 280$.
Savings me increase $= 280 - 200 = 80$ units (200 ke base par).
Percentage increase in savings $= \frac{80}{200} \times 100\% = 40\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  40% hai.

Method 2 (Weighted Average / Allegation):
Expenditure : Savings $= 3 : 2$.
Let savings growth be $S\%$.
$\frac{3 \times 15 + 2 \times S}{3 + 2} = 25 \implies 45 + 2S = 125 \implies 2S = 80 \implies S = 40\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '40%' hai.

Exam point: anupat ka tarika - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: A woman spends 3/4 of her income. If her income increases by 20% and the expenditure increases by 16%, then the percentage increase in her savings will be:
qh: एक महिला अपनी आय का 3/4 भाग खर्च करती है। यदि उसकी आय में 20% की वृद्धि होती है और खर्च में 16% की वृद्धि होती है, तो उसकी बचत में प्रतिशत वृद्धि क्या होगी?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Total Income $= 400$ units maan lo.
Expenditure $= \frac{3}{4} \times 400 = 300$ units.
Savings $= 400 - 300 = 100$ units.
New Income ($+20\%$): $400 + 80 = 480$.
New Expenditure ($+16\%$): $300 + 48 = 348$.
New Savings $= 480 - 348 = 132$.
Savings 100 se 132 ho gayi, yaani direct increase $= 132 - 100 = 32\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  32% hai.

Method 2 (Deviation / Allegation Method):
Expenditure weight $= 3$, Savings weight $= 1$.
Total Income deviation $= 20\%$.
$1 \times (\text{Savings}\% - 20) = 3 \times (20 - 16) = 12$.
$\text{Savings}\% = 20 + 12 = 32\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '32%' hai.

Exam point: pratishat ka hisaab - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: The proportion of Mohan's spending to saving is 4:1. His salary rises by 20%. What percentage of his expenditure will increase if his saving grows by 12%?
qh: मोहन के खर्च और बचत का अनुपात 4:1 है। उसके वेतन में 20% की वृद्धि होती है। यदि उसकी बचत में 12% की वृद्धि होती है, तो उसके खर्च में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि होगी?
e:
Method 1 (100-Base Method):
Spending $= 400$, Saving $= 100 \implies$ Total Salary $= 500$.
Salary increase ($20\%$): $500 + 100 = 600$.
Saving increase ($12\%$): $100 + 12 = 112$.
New Spending $= 600 - 112 = 488$.
Spending me badhav $= 488 - 400 = 88$ units (400 ke base par).
Percentage increase $= \frac{88}{400} \times 100\% = 22\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  22% hai.

Method 2 (Weighted Average Method):
Spending : Saving $= 4 : 1$.
Let expenditure increase be $E\%$.
$\frac{4 \times E + 1 \times 12}{4 + 1} = 20 \implies 4E + 12 = 100 \implies 4E = 88 \implies E = 22\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '22%' hai.

Exam point: pratishat ka hisaab - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: Karan spends 75% of his income. His income increases by 20% and his expenditure also increases by 8%. The percentage increase in his savings is:
qh: करण अपनी आय का 75% खर्च करता है। उसकी आय में 20% की वृद्धि होती है और उसके खर्च में भी 8% की वृद्धि होती है। उसकी बचत में प्रतिशत वृद्धि क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (100-Base Method):
Initial Income $= 100$.
Expenditure $= 75$, Savings $= 100 - 75 = 25$.
New Income ($+20\%$) $= 120$.
New Expenditure ($+8\%$) $= 75 + (8\% \text{ of } 75) = 75 + 6 = 81$.
New Savings $= 120 - 81 = 39$.
Increase in Savings $= 39 - 25 = 14$ units (25 ke base par).
Percentage increase $= \frac{14}{25} \times 100\% = 56\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  56% hai.

Method 2 (Allegation Method):
Expenditure : Savings $= 75 : 25 = 3 : 1$.
Let savings increase be $S\%$.
$1 \times (S - 20) = 3 \times (20 - 8) \implies S - 20 = 36 \implies S = 56\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '56%' hai.

Exam point: pratishat ka hisaab - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: Rohit spends 60% of his income. His income increased by 20% and his expenditure increased by 10%. What is the percentage increase in his savings?
qh: रोहित अपनी आय का 60% खर्च करता है। उसकी आय में 20% की वृद्धि हुई और उसके खर्च में 10% की वृद्धि हुई। उसकी बचत में प्रतिशत वृद्धि क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (100-Base Method):
Initial Income $= 100$.
Expenditure $= 60$, Savings $= 100 - 60 = 40$.
New Income ($+20\%$) $= 120$.
New Expenditure ($+10\%$) $= 60 + 6 = 66$.
New Savings $= 120 - 66 = 54$.
Savings me increase $= 54 - 40 = 14$ units (40 ke base par).
Percentage increase $= \frac{14}{40} \times 100\% = 35\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  35% hai.

Method 2 (Ratio / Weighted Average Method):
Expenditure : Savings $= 60 : 40 = 3 : 2$.
Total Income growth $= 20\%$, Expenditure growth $= 10\%$.
$\frac{3 \times 10 + 2 \times S}{5} = 20 \implies 30 + 2S = 100 \implies 2S = 70 \implies S = 35\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '35%' hai.

Exam point: pratishat ka hisaab - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: Vikas spends 70% of his income. His income is increased by 30% and he increases his expenditure by 20%. By what percentage are his savings increased?
qh: विकास अपनी आय का 70% खर्च करता है। उसकी आय में 30% की वृद्धि होती है और वह अपने खर्च में 20% की वृद्धि करता है। उसकी बचत में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि होगी?
e:
Method 1 (100-Base Method):
Initial Income $= 100$.
Expenditure $= 70$, Savings $= 30$.
New Income ($+30\%$) $= 130$.
New Expenditure ($+20\%$) $= 70 + 14 = 84$.
New Savings $= 130 - 84 = 46$.
Savings me increase $= 46 - 30 = 16$ units (30 ke base par).
Percentage increase $= \frac{16}{30} \times 100\% = \frac{160}{3}\% = 53.33\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  53.33% hai.

Method 2 (Ratio Method):
Expenditure : Savings $= 7 : 3$.
Total Income growth $= 30\%$, Expenditure growth $= 20\%$.
$\frac{7 \times 20 + 3 \times S}{10} = 30 \implies 140 + 3S = 300 \implies 3S = 160 \implies S = 53.33\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '53.33%' hai.

Exam point: pratishat ka hisaab - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: Sumit spends 85% of his income. His income increased by 20%, while his spending rose by 10%. The percentage increase in his savings is:
qh: सुमित अपनी आय का 85% खर्च करता है। उसकी आय में 20% की वृद्धि हुई, जबकि उसके खर्च में 10% की वृद्धि हुई। उसकी बचत में प्रतिशत वृद्धि क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (100-Base Method):
Initial Income $= 100$.
Spending $= 85$, Savings $= 100 - 85 = 15$.
New Income ($+20\%$) $= 120$.
New Spending ($+10\%$) $= 85 + 8.5 = 93.5$.
New Savings $= 120 - 93.5 = 26.5$.
Savings me increase $= 26.5 - 15 = 11.5$ units (15 ke base par).
Percentage increase $= \frac{11.5}{15} \times 100\% = \frac{23}{3}\% = 76.67\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  76.67% hai.

Method 2 (Ratio / Weighted Average Method):
Spending : Savings $= 85 : 15 = 17 : 3$.
Let savings rise be $S\%$.
$\frac{17 \times 10 + 3 \times S}{20} = 20 \implies 170 + 3S = 400 \implies 3S = 230 \implies S = 76.67\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '76.67%' hai.

Exam point: pratishat ka hisaab - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: Kavita spends 60% of her income. Her income increases by 20% and her expenditure increases by 10%. By what percentage does her saving increase?
qh: कविता अपनी आय का 60% खर्च करती है। उसकी आय में 20% की वृद्धि होती है और उसके खर्च में 10% की वृद्धि होती है। उसकी बचत में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि होगी?
e:
Method 1 (100-Base Method):
Initial Income $= 100$ maan lete hain.
Expenditure $= 60$, Savings $= 100 - 60 = 40$.
New Income ($+20\%$) $= 120$.
New Expenditure ($+10\%$) $= 60 + 6 = 66$.
New Savings $= 120 - 66 = 54$.
Savings me increase $= 54 - 40 = 14$ units (40 ke base par).
Percentage increase in savings $= \frac{14}{40} \times 100\% = 35\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  35% hai.

Method 2 (Ratio / Allegation Method):
Expenditure : Savings $= 60 : 40 = 3 : 2$.
Overall Income growth $= 20\%$, Expenditure growth $= 10\%$.
Let savings growth be $S\%$.
$\frac{3 \times 10 + 2 \times S}{3 + 2} = 20 \implies 30 + 2S = 100 \implies 2S = 70 \implies S = 35\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '35%' hai.

Exam point: pratishat ka hisaab - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: Dinesh spends 70% of his income. If his income is increased by 20% and his expenditure is increased by 10%, then the percentage increase in the savings of Dinesh will be:
qh: दिनेश अपनी आय का 70% खर्च करता है। यदि उसकी आय में 20% की वृद्धि होती है और उसके खर्च में 10% की वृद्धि होती है, तो दिनेश की बचत में प्रतिशत वृद्धि क्या होगी?
e:
Method 1 (100-Base Method):
Initial Income $= 100$.
Expenditure $= 70$, Savings $= 100 - 70 = 30$.
New Income ($+20\%$) $= 120$.
New Expenditure ($+10\%$) $= 70 + 7 = 77$.
New Savings $= 120 - 77 = 43$.
Savings me increase $= 43 - 30 = 13$ units (30 ke base par).
Percentage increase $= \frac{13}{30} \times 100\% = \frac{130}{3}\% \approx 43.33\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  43.33% hai.

Method 2 (Ratio Method):
Expenditure : Savings $= 7 : 3$.
Total Income rise $= 20\%$, Expenditure rise $= 10\%$.
Let savings growth be $S\%$.
$7 \times 10 + 3 \times S = 10 \times 20 \implies 70 + 3S = 200 \implies 3S = 130 \implies S = 43.33\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '43.33%' hai.

Exam point: pratishat ka hisaab - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: Pooja saves 25% of her income. If her income is increased by 20% and she saves 30% of the new income, by what percentage will her actual savings increase?
qh: पूजा अपनी आय का 25% बचाती है। यदि उसकी आय में 20% की वृद्धि होती है और वह नई आय का 30% बचाती है, तो उसकी वास्तविक बचत में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि होगी?
e:
Method 1 (100-Base Method):
Initial Income $= 100$ maan lo.
Initial Savings $= 25\% \text{ of } 100 = 25$.
New Income ($+20\%$) $= 120$.
New Savings $= 30\% \text{ of } 120 = 0.30 \times 120 = 36$.
Savings me increase $= 36 - 25 = 11$ units (25 ke base par).
Percentage increase in savings $= \frac{11}{25} \times 100\% = 44\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  44% hai.

Method 2 (Ratio Multiplier Method):
Initial savings $= 100 \times 0.25 = 25$.
New savings $= 100 \times 1.20 \times 0.30 = 36$.
Initial : New Savings $= 25 : 36$.
Increase $= 36 - 25 = 11$ units.
Percentage increase $= \frac{11}{25} \times 100\% = 44\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '44%' hai.

Exam point: pratishat ka hisaab - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: Manish could save 25% of his income. But 3 years later, when his income increased by 20%, he could save the same amount of money as before. By how much percentage did his expenditure increase?
qh: मनीष अपनी आय का 25% बचा सकता था। लेकिन 3 वर्ष बाद, जब उसकी आय में 20% की वृद्धि हुई, तो वह पहले जितनी ही राशि बचा सका। उसके खर्च में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि हुई?
e:
Method 1 (100-Base Method):
Initial Income $= 100$.
Initial Savings $= 25$, Initial Expenditure $= 100 - 25 = 75$.
New Income ($+20\%$) $= 120$.
Bachat pehle ke barabar hi hai $\implies$ New Savings $= 25$.
New Expenditure $= 120 - 25 = 95$.
Expenditure me increase $= 95 - 75 = 20$ units (75 ke base par).
Percentage increase in expenditure $= \frac{20}{75} \times 100\% = \frac{4}{15} \times 100\% = 26.67\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  26.67% hai.

Method 2 (Ratio Method):
Initial Income : Savings : Expenditure $= 4 : 1 : 3$.
Scale by 25: Income $= 100$, Savings $= 25$, Expenditure $= 75$.
Income ho gayi 120, savings rahi 25, toh kharch ho gaya 95.
Increase in expenditure $= \frac{95 - 75}{75} \times 100\% = \frac{20}{75} \times 100\% = 26.67\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '26.67%' hai.

Exam point: pratishat ka hisaab - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: Sunil spends 50% of his income on household items. If his income increases by 30% and his expenditure increases by 10%, then find the percentage change in his savings.
qh: सुनील अपनी आय का 50% घरेलू वस्तुओं पर खर्च करता है। यदि उसकी आय में 30% की वृद्धि होती है और उसके खर्च में 10% की वृद्धि होती है, तो उसकी बचत में प्रतिशत परिवर्तन ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Method 1 (100-Base Method):
Initial Income $= 100$.
Expenditure $= 50$, Savings $= 50$.
New Income ($+30\%$) $= 130$.
New Expenditure ($+10\%$) $= 50 + 5 = 55$.
New Savings $= 130 - 55 = 75$.
Savings me increase $= 75 - 50 = 25$ units (50 ke base par).
Percentage increase $= \frac{25}{50} \times 100\% = 50\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  50% increase hai.

Method 2 (Direct Weighted Relation):
Kyunki Expenditure aur Savings dono barabar ($1 : 1$) hain:
$\text{Income growth} = \frac{\text{Exp growth} + \text{Sav growth}}{2}$
$30\% = \frac{10\% + S}{2} \implies 10\% + S = 60\% \implies S = 50\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '50% increase' hai.

Exam point: pratishat ka hisaab - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: The monthly income of a person is ₹20,000 and his expenditure is ₹15,000. Next year, his income increases by 20% but his expenditure decreases by 10%. The percentage increase in his savings is:
qh: एक व्यक्ति की मासिक आय ₹20,000 है और उसका खर्च ₹15,000 है। अगले वर्ष, उसकी आय में 20% की वृद्धि होती है लेकिन उसके खर्च में 10% की कमी आती है। उसकी बचत में प्रतिशत वृद्धि क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (Absolute Value Method):
Initial Savings $= 20000 - 15000 = ₹5000$.
New Income ($+20\%$) $= 20000 + 4000 = ₹24000$.
New Expenditure ($-10\%$) $= 15000 - 1500 = ₹13500$.
New Savings $= 24000 - 13500 = ₹10500$.
Increase in savings $= 10500 - 5000 = ₹5500$.
Percentage increase $= \frac{5500}{5000} \times 100\% = 110\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  110% hai.

Method 2 (Ratio Method):
Income : Expenditure : Savings $= 20000 : 15000 : 5000 = 4 : 3 : 1$.
Base scale: Income $= 400$, Exp $= 300$, Sav $= 100$.
New Income ($+20\%$) $= 480$.
New Exp ($-10\%$) $= 270$.
New Sav $= 480 - 270 = 210$.
Savings increase $= 210 - 100 = 110\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '110%' hai.

Exam point: pratishat ka hisaab - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: The ratio of expenditure to savings of a woman is 3:1. If her income and expenditure are increased by 20% and 12%, respectively, then find the percentage change in her savings.
qh: एक महिला के खर्च और बचत का अनुपात 3:1 है। यदि उसकी आय और खर्च में क्रमशः 20% और 12% की वृद्धि होती है, तो उसकी बचत में प्रतिशत परिवर्तन ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Method 1 (100-Base Scaling Method):
Expenditure $= 300$, Savings $= 100 \implies$ Total Income $= 400$.
New Income ($+20\%$) $= 400 + 80 = 480$.
New Expenditure ($+12\%$) $= 300 + 36 = 336$.
New Savings $= 480 - 336 = 144$.
Savings me increase $= 144 - 100 = 44$ units (100 ke base par).
Percentage change $= 44\%$ increase.
Atah sahi vikalp  44% hai.

Method 2 (Deviation / Allegation Method):
Expenditure weight $= 3$, Savings weight $= 1$.
Average income growth $= 20\%$.
$1 \times (S - 20) = 3 \times (20 - 12) \implies S - 20 = 24 \implies S = 44\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '44%' hai.

Exam point: anupat ka tarika - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: The monthly income of Amit in 2022 was ₹24,000 and his monthly expenditure was ₹16,000. In 2023, his income increased by 25% and his expenditure increased by 10%. Find the percentage increase in his savings.
qh: वर्ष 2022 में अमित की मासिक आय ₹24,000 थी और उसका मासिक खर्च ₹16,000 था। वर्ष 2023 में उसकी आय में 25% और खर्च में 10% की वृद्धि हुई। उसकी बचत में प्रतिशत वृद्धि ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Initial Income : Expenditure : Savings $= 24000 : 16000 : 8000 = 3 : 2 : 1$.
Base scale: Income $= 300$, Exp $= 200$, Sav $= 100$.
New Income ($+25\%$) $= 300 + 75 = 375$.
New Exp ($+10\%$) $= 200 + 20 = 220$.
New Savings $= 375 - 220 = 155$.
Increase in savings $= 155 - 100 = 55\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  55% hai.

Method 2 (Absolute Value Method):
Initial savings $= 24000 - 16000 = ₹8000$.
New Income $= 24000 + 6000 = ₹30000$.
New Expenditure $= 16000 + 1600 = ₹17600$.
New Savings $= 30000 - 17600 = ₹12400$.
Savings increase $= 12400 - 8000 = ₹4400$.
Percentage increase $= \frac{4400}{8000} \times 100\% = 55\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '55%' hai.

Exam point: pratishat ka hisaab - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: Vipin's expenditure and savings are in the ratio of 4:1. His income increases by 20%. If his savings increase by 15%, then by how much percentage does his expenditure increase?
qh: विपिन के खर्च और बचत का अनुपात 4:1 है। उसकी आय में 20% की वृद्धि होती है। यदि उसकी बचत में 15% की वृद्धि होती है, तो उसके खर्च में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि होगी?
e:
Method 1 (100-Base Scaling Method):
Expenditure $= 400$, Savings $= 100 \implies$ Total Income $= 500$.
Income increase ($20\%$): $500 + 100 = 600$.
Savings increase ($15\%$): $100 + 15 = 115$.
New Expenditure $= 600 - 115 = 485$.
Expenditure me badhav $= 485 - 400 = 85$ units (400 ke base par).
Percentage increase $= \frac{85}{400} \times 100\% = 21.25\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  21.25% hai.

Method 2 (Weighted Average Method):
Expenditure : Savings $= 4 : 1$.
Let expenditure increase be $E\%$.
$\frac{4 \times E + 1 \times 15}{5} = 20 \implies 4E + 15 = 100 \implies 4E = 85 \implies E = 21.25\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '21.25%' hai.

Exam point: anupat ka tarika - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: The monthly expenditure of a person is 50% more than his monthly savings. If his monthly income increases by 30% and monthly expenditure increases by 40%, then he saves ₹1,500 more in a month. What is his initial monthly expenditure (in ₹)?
qh: एक व्यक्ति का मासिक खर्च उसकी मासिक बचत से 50% अधिक है। यदि उसकी मासिक आय में 30% और मासिक खर्च में 40% की वृद्धि होती है, तो वह प्रति माह ₹1,500 अधिक बचाता है। उसका प्रारंभिक मासिक खर्च (₹ में) क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Scaling Method):
Expenditure savings se $50\% = \frac{1}{2}$ zyada hai $\implies$ Savings $= 200$ units, Expenditure $= 300$ units.
Initial Income $= 200 + 300 = 500$ units.
New Income ($+30\%$): $500 + 150 = 650$ units.
New Expenditure ($+40\%$): $300 + 120 = 420$ units.
New Savings $= 650 - 420 = 230$ units.
Savings me increase $= 230 - 200 = 30$ units.
Given: 30 units $= ₹1500 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = \frac{1500}{30} = ₹50$.
Initial Expenditure = 300 units $= 300 \times 50 = ₹15,000$.
Atah sahi vikalp  ₹15,000 hai.

Method 2 (Algebraic Formulation):
Let initial savings $= 2x$, expenditure $= 3x$, income $= 5x$.
New income $= 5x \times 1.30 = 6.5x$.
New expenditure $= 3x \times 1.40 = 4.2x$.
New savings $= 6.5x - 4.2x = 2.3x$.
Increase in savings $= 2.3x - 2x = 0.3x$.
Given: $0.3x = 1500 \implies x = 5000$.
Initial Expenditure $= 3x = 3 \times 5000 = ₹15,000$.
Atah sahi uttar '₹15,000' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: Raghu used to spend 75% of his income. His income has increased by 15%, and he increases his expenditure by 10%. If Raghu earlier saved y and after the increases he now saves x, then what is the value of ((x - y) / y * 100)%?
qh: रघु अपनी आय का 75% खर्च करता था। उसकी आय में 15% की वृद्धि हुई है, और वह अपने खर्च में 10% की वृद्धि करता है। यदि रघु पहले y बचाता था और वृद्धि के बाद अब वह x बचाता है, तो ((x - y) / y * 100)% का मान क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (100-Base Method):
$\left(\frac{x - y}{y} \times 100\right)\%$ ka matlab seedhe savings ka percentage increase nikalna hai.
Initial Income $= 100$.
Initial Expenditure $= 75$, Initial Savings ($y$) $= 100 - 75 = 25$.
New Income ($+15\%$) $= 115$.
New Expenditure ($+10\%$) $= 75 + 7.5 = 82.5$.
New Savings ($x$) $= 115 - 82.5 = 32.5$.
Savings increase $= x - y = 32.5 - 25 = 7.5$.
Percentage increase $= \frac{7.5}{25} \times 100\% = 30\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  30% hai.

Method 2 (Ratio Method):
Expenditure : Savings $= 75 : 25 = 3 : 1$.
Overall Income rise $= 15\%$, Expenditure rise $= 10\%$.
$1 \times (S - 15) = 3 \times (15 - 10) \implies S - 15 = 15 \implies S = 30\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '30%' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: A person saves 40% of his income. Next year, his income increases by 150%. He increases his savings by four times the previous year's savings. By what percentage has his expenditure decreased?
qh: एक व्यक्ति अपनी आय का 40% बचाता है। अगले वर्ष, उसकी आय में 150% की वृद्धि होती है। वह अपनी बचत में पिछले वर्ष की बचत के चार गुना की वृद्धि करता है। उसके खर्च में कितने प्रतिशत की कमी आई है?
e:
Method 1 (100-Base Method):
Initial Income $= 100$.
Initial Savings $= 40$, Initial Expenditure $= 100 - 40 = 60$.
New Income ($+150\%$) $= 100 + 150 = 250$.
Savings me increase pichli savings ka 4 guna hai $\implies \text{Increase} = 4 \times 40 = 160$.
New Savings $= 40 + 160 = 200$.
New Expenditure $= 250 - 200 = 50$.
Expenditure me kami $= 60 - 50 = 10$ units (60 ke base par).
Percentage decrease $= \frac{10}{60} \times 100\% = \frac{1}{6} \times 100\% = 16.67\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  16.67% hai.

Method 2 (Ratio Balance Method):
Base ratio: Savings $= 2$, Expenditure $= 3$, Income $= 5$.
New Income $= 5 \times 2.5 = 12.5$.
Savings increase $= 2 \times 4 = 8 \implies$ New Savings $= 2 + 8 = 10$.
New Expenditure $= 12.5 - 10 = 2.5$.
Expenditure me kami $= 3 - 2.5 = 0.5$ units.
Percentage decrease $= \frac{0.5}{3} \times 100\% = 16.67\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '16.67%' hai.

Exam point: pratishat ka hisaab - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: Tina used to save 25% of her income. If her income went up by 20%, while her expenditure went up by 30%, her nominal saving went down by ₹500. Find Tina's initial income (in ₹).
qh: टीना अपनी आय का 25% बचाती थी। यदि उसकी आय में 20% की वृद्धि हुई, जबकि उसके खर्च में 30% की वृद्धि हुई, तो उसकी नाममात्र बचत में ₹500 की कमी आई। टीना की प्रारंभिक आय (₹ में) ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Method 1 (100-Base Method):
Initial Income $= 100$ units.
Savings $= 25$ units, Expenditure $= 75$ units.
New Income ($+20\%$) $= 120$ units.
New Expenditure ($+30\%$) $= 75 + 22.5 = 97.5$ units.
New Savings $= 120 - 97.5 = 22.5$ units.
Decrease in Savings $= 25 - 22.5 = 2.5$ units.
Given: 2.5 units $= ₹500 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = ₹200$.
Initial Income (100 units) $= 100 \times 200 = ₹20000$.
Atah sahi vikalp  ₹20,000 hai.

Method 2 (Ratio Method):
Income : Savings : Expenditure $= 400 : 100 : 300$.
New Income $= 480$, New Expenditure $= 390$.
New Savings $= 480 - 390 = 90$.
Savings drop $= 100 - 90 = 10$ units.
10 units $= ₹500 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = ₹50$.
Initial Income = 400 units $= 400 \times 50 = ₹20000$.
Atah sahi uttar '₹20,000' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: A person earns ₹20,000 per month and spends 75% of his income and saves the remaining amount. If his income increases by 25% and expenditure by 10%, find the percentage of increase in his savings.
qh: एक व्यक्ति प्रति माह ₹20,000 कमाता है और अपनी आय का 75% खर्च करता है तथा शेष राशि बचाता है। यदि उसकी आय में 25% और खर्च में 10% की वृद्धि होती है, तो उसकी बचत में प्रतिशत वृद्धि ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Method 1 (100-Base Method):
Actual value (₹20,000) ka use kiye bina direct 100 base par solve kar sakte hain:
Initial Income $= 100$.
Expenditure $= 75$, Savings $= 25$.
New Income ($+25\%$) $= 125$.
New Expenditure ($+10\%$) $= 75 + 7.5 = 82.5$.
New Savings $= 125 - 82.5 = 42.5$.
Increase in savings $= 42.5 - 25 = 17.5$ units (25 ke base par).
Percentage increase $= \frac{17.5}{25} \times 100\% = 70\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  70% hai.

Method 2 (Deviation / Allegation Method):
Expenditure : Savings $= 75 : 25 = 3 : 1$.
Total Income growth $= 25\%$, Expenditure growth $= 10\%$.
$1 \times (S - 25) = 3 \times (25 - 10) \implies S - 25 = 45 \implies S = 70\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '70%' hai.

Exam point: pratishat ka hisaab - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: The ratio between the monthly income and the expenditure of Varun is 7:4. If his income increases by 25% and his expenditure increases by 20%, then find the percentage increase in his savings.
qh: वरुण की मासिक आय और खर्च के बीच का अनुपात 7:4 है। यदि उसकी आय में 25% और उसके खर्च में 20% की वृद्धि होती है, तो उसकी बचत में प्रतिशत वृद्धि ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Method 1 (100-Base Scaling Method):
Income $= 700$, Expenditure $= 400$.
Savings $= 700 - 400 = 300$.
New Income ($+25\%$): $700 + 175 = 875$.
New Expenditure ($+20\%$): $400 + 80 = 480$.
New Savings $= 875 - 480 = 395$.
Savings me increase $= 395 - 300 = 95$ units (300 ke base par).
Percentage increase $= \frac{95}{300} \times 100\% = \frac{95}{3}\% \approx 31.67\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  31.67% hai.

Method 2 (Weighted Average Method):
Expenditure : Savings $= 4 : 3$.
Total Income increase $= 25\%$, Expenditure increase $= 20\%$.
$\frac{4 \times 20 + 3 \times S}{7} = 25 \implies 80 + 3S = 175 \implies 3S = 95 \implies S = 31.67\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '31.67%' hai.

Exam point: anupat ka tarika - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: A man spends 70% of his income. His income increases by 10% and his expenditure by 5%. What is the percentage increase in his savings?
qh: एक व्यक्ति अपनी आय का 70% खर्च करता है। उसकी आय में 10% और उसके खर्च में 5% की वृद्धि होती है। उसकी बचत में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि होगी?
e:
Method 1 (100-Base Method):
Initial Income $= 100$ maan lete hain.
Expenditure $= 70$, Savings $= 100 - 70 = 30$.
New Income ($+10\%$) $= 110$.
New Expenditure ($+5\%$) $= 70 + 3.5 = 73.5$.
New Savings $= 110 - 73.5 = 36.5$.
Savings me increase $= 36.5 - 30 = 6.5$ units (30 ke base par).
Percentage increase $= \frac{6.5}{30} \times 100\% = \frac{65}{3}\% \approx 21.67\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  21.67% hai.

Method 2 (Alligation / Weighted Average Method):
Expenditure : Savings $= 70 : 30 = 7 : 3$.
Total income growth $= 10\%$, Expenditure growth $= 5\%$.
Let savings growth be $S\%$.
$\frac{7 \times 5 + 3 \times S}{10} = 10 \implies 35 + 3S = 100 \implies 3S = 65 \implies S = 21.67\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '21.67%' hai.

Exam point: pratishat ka hisaab - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: Mr. X has a monthly income of ₹26,500 and his monthly expenditure is ₹20,500. The next year, his salary is increased by 12% and expenditure is increased by 6%. His savings increase by how much percent?
qh: श्रीमान X की मासिक आय ₹26,500 है और उनका मासिक खर्च ₹20,500 है। अगले वर्ष, उनके वेतन में 12% और खर्च में 6% की वृद्धि होती है। उनकी बचत में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि होगी?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Initial Income : Expenditure : Savings
$= 26500 : 20500 : 6000 = 53 : 41 : 12$.
Income increase $= 53 \times 12\% = 6.36$ units.
Expenditure increase $= 41 \times 6\% = 2.46$ units.
Savings increase $= 6.36 - 2.46 = 3.90$ units.
Percentage increase in savings $= \frac{3.90}{12} \times 100\% = \frac{390}{12}\% = 32.5\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  32.5% hai.

Method 2 (Absolute Value Method):
Initial savings $= 26500 - 20500 = ₹6000$.
Income increase $= 12\% \text{ of } 26500 = ₹3180$.
Expenditure increase $= 6\% \text{ of } 20500 = ₹1230$.
Increase in savings $= 3180 - 1230 = ₹1950$.
Percentage increase $= \frac{1950}{6000} \times 100\% = 32.5\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '32.5%' hai.

Exam point: pratishat ka hisaab - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: A spends 65% of his income. His income is increased by 20.1% and the expenditure is increased by 20%. By what percent (correct to one decimal place) does his saving increase or decrease?
qh: A अपनी आय का 65% खर्च करता है। उसकी आय में 20.1% की वृद्धि होती है और खर्च में 20% की वृद्धि होती है। उसकी बचत में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि या कमी होती है (एक दशमलव स्थान तक सही)?
e:
Method 1 (100-Base Method):
Initial Income $= 100$.
Expenditure $= 65$, Savings $= 100 - 65 = 35$.
New Income $= 100 + 20.1 = 120.1$.
New Expenditure $= 65 + (20\% \text{ of } 65) = 65 + 13 = 78$.
New Savings $= 120.1 - 78 = 42.1$.
Savings me increase $= 42.1 - 35 = 7.1$ units (35 ke base par).
Percentage increase $= \frac{7.1}{35} \times 100\% = \frac{142}{7}\% \approx 20.285\% \approx 20.3\%$ increase.
Atah sahi vikalp  Increase by 20.3% hai.

Method 2 (Ratio / Weighted Average Method):
Expenditure : Savings $= 65 : 35 = 13 : 7$.
Total Income growth $= 20.1\%$, Expenditure growth $= 20\%$.
$\frac{13 \times 20 + 7 \times S}{20} = 20.1 \implies 260 + 7S = 402 \implies 7S = 142 \implies S \approx 20.3\%$ increase.
Atah sahi uttar 'Increase by 20.3%' hai.

Exam point: pratishat ka hisaab - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: Radha saves x% of her income. If her income increases by 28% and the expenditure increases by 20%, then her savings increases by 40%. What is the value of x?
qh: राधा अपनी आय का x% बचाती है। यदि उसकी आय में 28% की वृद्धि होती है और खर्च में 20% की वृद्धि होती है, तो उसकी बचत में 40% की वृद्धि होती है। x का मान क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (Alligation Method):
Expenditure growth $= 20\%$, Savings growth $= 40\%$.
Overall Income growth $= 28\%$.
Alligation rule lagane par:
Expenditure : Savings $= (40 - 28) : (28 - 20) = 12 : 8 = 3 : 2$.
Total Income $= 3 + 2 = 5$ units.
Savings percentage ($x$) $= \frac{2}{5} \times 100 = 40\% \implies x = 40$.
Atah sahi vikalp  40 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Algebraic Method):
Initial Income $= 100$.
Savings $= x$, Expenditure $= 100 - x$.
Total Income hike $=$ Expenditure hike $+$ Savings hike:
$100 \times 28\% = (100 - x) \times 20\% + x \times 40\%$
$28 = 20 - 0.20x + 0.40x \implies 8 = 0.20x \implies x = 40$.
Atah sahi uttar '40' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: In a class, the ratio of the number of boys to that of the girls is 11:9. 30% of the boys and 20% of the girls passed an exam. Find the percentage of students who passed the exam.
qh: एक कक्षा में लड़कों और लड़कियों की संख्या का अनुपात 11:9 है। 30% लड़के और 20% लड़कियां एक परीक्षा में उत्तीर्ण हुए। परीक्षा उत्तीर्ण करने वाले विद्यार्थियों का प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Method 1 (Weighted Average Method):
Ratio of Boys : Girls $= 11 : 9$.
Total students $= 11 + 9 = 20$ units.
Overall Pass Percentage $= \frac{(11 \times 30\%) + (9 \times 20\%)}{11 + 9} = \frac{330 + 180}{20} = \frac{510}{20} = 25.5\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  25.5% hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Assumption Method):
Boys $= 110$, Girls $= 90 \implies$ Total students $= 200$.
Passed Boys $= 30\% \text{ of } 110 = 33$.
Passed Girls $= 20\% \text{ of } 90 = 18$.
Total Passed students $= 33 + 18 = 51$.
Pass Percentage $= \frac{51}{200} \times 100\% = 25.5\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '25.5%' hai.

Exam point: anupat ka tarika - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: Suhani pays tax at the rate of 30% on her entire income of ₹90,000 and Ritika pays tax at the rate of 40% on her entire income of ₹y. If the overall tax rate on their combined income comes to 37%, then what is the value of y?
qh: सुहानी अपनी ₹90,000 की पूरी आय पर 30% की दर से कर का भुगतान करती है और रितिका अपनी ₹y की पूरी आय पर 40% की दर से कर का भुगतान करती है। यदि उनकी संयुक्त आय पर कुल कर की दर 37% आती है, तो y का मान क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (Alligation Method):
Suhani ka tax rate $= 30\%$, Ritika ka tax rate $= 40\%$.
Combined average tax rate $= 37\%$.
Alligation rule apply karne par:
Suhani's Income : Ritika's Income $= (40 - 37) : (37 - 30) = 3 : 7$.
Given: Suhani's Income (3 units) $= ₹90000 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = ₹30000$.
Ritika's Income ($y$) = 7 units $= 7 \times 30000 = ₹210000$.
Atah sahi vikalp  ₹2,10,000 hai.

Method 2 (Weighted Equation Method):
$0.37 \times (90000 + y) = (0.30 \times 90000) + 0.40y$
$33300 + 0.37y = 27000 + 0.40y$
$6300 = 0.03y \implies y = \frac{6300}{0.03} = ₹210000$.
Atah sahi uttar '₹2,10,000' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: The average pass percentage of girls in class X examination in a school is 85% and that of boys is 83%. The average pass percentage of all boys and girls in class X of that school is 83.7%. Find the percentage of the number of girls in class X of that school.
qh: एक स्कूल में कक्षा X की परीक्षा में लड़कियों का औसत उत्तीर्ण प्रतिशत 85% है और लड़कों का 83% है। उस स्कूल की कक्षा X के सभी लड़कों और लड़कियों का औसत उत्तीर्ण प्रतिशत 83.7% है। उस स्कूल की कक्षा X में लड़कियों की संख्या का प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Method 1 (Alligation Method):
Girls pass % = 85%, Boys pass % = 83%.
Overall combined pass % = 83.7%.
Alligation rule apply karne par:
Ratio of Girls : Boys = (83.7 - 83) : (85 - 83.7) = 0.7 : 1.3 = 7 : 13.
Total students = 7 + 13 = 20 units.
Percentage of girls = $\frac{7}{20}$ $\times$ 100% = 35%.
Atah sahi vikalp  35% hai.

Method 2 (Algebraic Weighted Average Method):
Maana total students = 100 aur girls = g%.
Boys = (100 - g)%.
85g + 83(100 - g) = 100 $\times$ 83.7
2g = 8370 - 8300 = 70 \implies g = 35%.
Atah sahi uttar '35%' hai.

Exam point: ausat ka sootra - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: In a certain year, the population of a city was 18,000. If in the next year, the population of males increased by 5% and that of females increased by 7%, and the total population increased to 19,200, then what was the ratio of the population of males and females in that given year?
qh: किसी निश्चित वर्ष में एक शहर की जनसंख्या 18,000 थी। यदि अगले वर्ष पुरुषों की जनसंख्या में 5% की वृद्धि हुई और महिलाओं की जनसंख्या में 7% की वृद्धि हुई, और कुल जनसंख्या बढ़कर 19,200 हो गई, तो उस दिए गए वर्ष में पुरुषों और महिलाओं की जनसंख्या का अनुपात क्या था?
e:
Method 1 (Alligation Method):
Total population increase = 19200 - 18000 = 1200.
Overall percentage increase = $\frac{1200}{18000}$ $\times$ 100% = $\frac{20}{3}$%.
Ratio of Males : Females:
= $\le$ft(7 - $\frac{20}{3}$\right) : $\le$ft($\frac{20}{3}$ - 5\right) = $\frac{1}{3}$ : $\frac{5}{3}$ = 1 : 5.
Atah sahi vikalp  1 : 5 hai.

Method 2 (Shift / Deviation Method):
Agar dono 5% badhte: 18000 $\times$ 5% = 900.
Extra increase = 1200 - 900 = 300.
2% of Females = 300 \implies Females = 15000.
Males = 18000 - 15000 = 3000.
Ratio of Males : Females = 3000 : 15000 = 1 : 5.
Atah sahi uttar '1 : 5' hai.

Exam point: anupat ka tarika - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: In a city, the current number of literate people is 25,000. If the number of literate males decreases by 5% and the number of literate females increases by 10%, the total literate population becomes 25,250. What is the present number of literate males in the city?
qh: एक शहर में साक्षर व्यक्तियों की वर्तमान संख्या 25,000 है। यदि साक्षर पुरुषों की संख्या में 5% की कमी होती है और साक्षर महिलाओं की संख्या में 10% की वृद्धि होती है, तो कुल साक्षर जनसंख्या 25,250 हो जाती है। शहर में साक्षर पुरुषों की वर्तमान संख्या क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (Shift / Deviation Method):
Net change in population = 25250 - 25000 = +250.
Agar sabhi +10% badhte: 25000 $\times$ 10% = +2500.
Difference = 2500 - 250 = 2250.
Yeh deviation Males ke [10% - (-5%)] = 15% ke barabar hai:
15% of M = 2250 \implies M = $\frac{2250}{15}$ $\times$ 100 = 15000.
Present literate males = 15,000.
Atah sahi vikalp  15,000 hai.

Method 2 (Alligation Method):
Overall net growth % = $\frac{250}{25000}$ $\times$ 100% = +1%.
Males change = -5%, Females change = +10%.
Males : Females = (10 - 1) : (1 - (-5)) = 9 : 6 = 3 : 2.
Total 5 units = 25000 \implies 1 unit = 5000.
Males = 3 units = 3 $\times$ 5000 = 15,000.
Atah sahi uttar '15,000' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.
